class_level_violations.statement: _decode calls broker.header_prefix(176 if SAV else 512) UNCONDITIONALLY for every source and format. Only SRC26's class admits a header-prefix read. The other six sources therefore perform an operation their frozen class does not admit, and SRC27 additionally performs an invented 512-byte DTA operation that appears nowhere in the freeze.

there is no route-pass account. SRC27's expected_full_route_passes=1/max=1 has no counter or budget in the broker, so a second governed pass could not be refused on the strength of that frozen constraint.
decoder_invocations is absent from both SourceAccessAccount and SourceAccessBudget, although O1-C07 lists it as a mandatory separate account.
